description: Repo-scale (cpp-eventbus): add pagination to EventLog::historyPage that must compose with the existing topic filter, not bypass it
prompts: Add `std::vector<Event> EventLog::historyPage(bool hasFilter, const std::string& topicFilter, int page, int pageSize, int* outTotal) const`. When `hasFilter` is true, restrict to entries whose topic exactly matches `topicFilter`. `page` (1-based) and `pageSize` must both be >= 1, else return an empty vector with `*outTotal` set to 0. Otherwise, write the count of ALL matching entries (not just the page) to `*outTotal`, and return just that page's slice. Pagination must be applied AFTER the topic filter, not before - `*outTotal` must reflect the filtered count, and the returned page must be the correct slice of the FILTERED result set, not a slice of the raw history filtered down afterward.
name: add_cpp_eventbus_history_pagination
